description: This Java class, KeyManagerFactoryFactory, is a factory implementation for creating javax.net.ssl.KeyManagerFactory instances using client certificate credentials in a security-related context, likely for SSL/TLS configuration in a messaging service. It handles parsing PEM formatted keys and certificates, managing keystores, and integrating with a larger connectivity framework.

classes.name: KeyManagerFactoryFactory
classes.description: A factory class to create configured KeyManagerFactory instances for SSL/TLS client authentication based on PEM-encoded certificates and private keys.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new KeyManagerFactoryFactory with default empty DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new KeyManagerFactoryFactory with specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: newKeyManagerFactory
methods.description: Builds a KeyManagerFactory from PEM-formatted client key and certificate strings.

methods.name: getClientPrivateKey
methods.description: Parses PEM formatted private key string to a PrivateKey object.

methods.name: getClientCertificate
methods.description: Creates an X.509 Certificate object from PEM-formatted certificate string.

methods.name: pemRegex
methods.description: Constructs a regex pattern to extract base64 content from a PEM block with a specific label.

methods.name: decodeBase64
methods.description: Decodes a Base64-encoded string, ignoring whitespace.

methods.name: clientCertificate
methods.description: Implements the CredentialsVisitor interface method; creates a KeyManagerFactory from client credentials.
